name: @chartcoach/catalog
description: JavaScript models and artifact parsers for the chartcoach visualization guideline catalog.
author: Péter Ferenc Gyarmati <dev.petergy@gmail.com>

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --force && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json --resolve-full-paths --resolve-full-extension .js
scripts.format: oxfmt src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json vitest.config.ts --check
